reconciliation.scope: Full English adaptation of the approved Russian derivative, including all figures, captions, alt text, sections, notes and bibliographic references. Original image bytes, rights and source destinations retained.

editorial_review.reviewer: Codex (AI language and mathematical consistency review; not human publication approval)
passes: Adaptation against the complete Russian article
English copy-edit for idiom, terminology, clarity, attribution and bibliographic accuracy
decisions: Defined proper divisors in plain English before introducing deficient, abundant and perfect numbers; retained every TeX expression.
Kept 51 known even perfect numbers, the exponent and digit count explicitly tied to the source's 2019 snapshot, not presented as today's record.
Used a traditional attribution to the sixth-century BCE Pythagoreans rather than asserting a documented invention date.
Presented the 28-day lunar cycle as a traditional symbolic association rather than an exact orbital period; avoided implying that no large perfect numbers were found before computers.
Retained original artwork and Russian book-cover lettering with English alternative text and captions; no translated English book edition is claimed.
